title: Count oxygen anion unpaired electrons
hints: Add one electron to neutral O₂.
Apply Pauli and Hund to the π* pair.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: There are three electrons in the two degenerate π* orbitals: one pair and one single.
statement:
How many unpaired electrons are predicted for $\ce{O2^-}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: Three electrons occupy two boxes as one pair and one single.
Four electrons would pair both π* orbitals.
There are only two π* boxes.
